name: Book PDF
tagline: Write a book on any subject, with chapters, diagrams, math and callouts, and get back a typeset PDF you can print.
who: Anyone who wants a dense reference on a subject they need to learn or teach: a founder onboarding into a new domain, a team that needs a shared primer, a person who prefers to read on paper.
how:
Your agent asks what the book is about, who reads it, how long it should be, and whether it is for the screen or for print. Then:

- It writes a shared fact sheet and voice guide, so every chapter agrees with the others.
- It hands each chapter to its own worker, so a twelve-chapter book is written in parallel.
- Each chapter is markdown with embedded diagrams, typeset math, definition and warning boxes, and tables.
- The build renders one PDF on the agent's own computer, with chapter openers, running headers, figure numbers, a glossary and page numbers.

You get a download link and preview pages. Nothing is sent to an outside service.
